Maintenance/runtime field-validation scope
------------------------------------------

v0.4.2 live fail-closed Security Manager semantics probe. It adds a clearer
runner interpreter contract and records project-host field validation on
Open Object Rexx 5.2.0 r0.

Runner interpreter contract
---------------------------
REXX and OOREXX_REXX identify ONE executable pathname/name. They are not shell
command strings. For example:
  OOREXX_REXX=/usr/local/bin/rexx ./run_tests.sh ../oorexx_crypto_v0.1/src

Do NOT set:
  REXX="time rexx"

To time the suite portably:
  time ./run_tests.sh ../oorexx_crypto_v0.1/src

Both crypto dependency forms are accepted:
  ./run_tests.sh ../oorexx_crypto_v0.1/src
  ./run_tests.sh ../oorexx_crypto_v0.1/src/crypto.cls
